llm.summary: This skill is a coherent local video-subtitling workflow, with expected local command execution and file creation but no evidence of credential use, exfiltration, or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: The described purpose—transcribing local videos with Whisper and rendering word-highlighted subtitles with Remotion—matches the README, SKILL.md workflow, required binaries, and helper script behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to run local media-processing and rendering commands against user-provided files. This is purpose-aligned, but users should verify input and output paths before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, and Remotion project dependencies are expected to exist in a generated or reused local project. This is not suspicious by itself, but those dependencies are outside the reviewed artifact set.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The workflow reads local video/audio, creates transcript-derived JSON, copies or re-encodes media into a Remotion project, and writes a rendered video next to the source. This is proportionate to the task but may involve private media content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates persistent local outputs and intermediate files, but there is no evidence of background services, credential access, account privileges, or autonomous persistence beyond the requested render workflow.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears safe for its stated purpose if you are comfortable letting the agent run local video/transcription/rendering tools on the selected file. Before installing or invoking it, make sure the video path is correct, use trusted Remotion/npm dependencies, and remember that transcript and caption JSON files may remain on disk after rendering.

evidence.explanation: The skill directs the agent to run multiple local CLI tools and create or modify files as part of the subtitle-rendering workflow. This is expected for the stated purpose, but it is still meaningful local execution and file-write authority.
evidence.snippet: Inspect the source with `ffprobe` ... Run Whisper ... Convert the Whisper JSON ... Build or reuse a small Remotion project ... Render with Remotion to the output path next to the source.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use explicit input and output paths, keep backups of important media, and review the planned commands if the source directory contains files you do not want changed.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may read the chosen video, create intermediate project files, and write the finished video in the same directory.

evidence.explanation: The reviewed package includes a helper script, but the actual Remotion project and npm dependencies used for rendering are expected to come from a generated or reused local project rather than a pinned reviewed install spec.
evidence.snippet: Remotion dependencies in the generated or reused Remotion project

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use a trusted Remotion project, prefer pinned dependencies or a lockfile, and avoid running npm commands in untrusted directories.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: If the agent installs or runs npm/Remotion dependencies from an existing or newly generated project, that code may not be covered by this skill review.

evidence.explanation: The helper writes transcript-derived caption data to a persistent local JSON file. This is necessary for the workflow, but it can preserve spoken video content as text.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Run the workflow in a trusted local folder and delete intermediate transcript or caption files after rendering if the video contains sensitive content.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private speech from the video may be stored in local transcript or caption files in addition to the rendered video.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses local media-processing and rendering commands, and may rely on external Remotion/npm project dependencies, but this is aligned with the stated subtitle-rendering purpose.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, elevated privileges, or delegated authority are requested or shown in the artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The workflow can create local text transcripts/caption files from private video content, but there is no artifact evidence of upload or external sharing.
